A '''raid''' on the planet [[Corsin/Legends|Corsin]] occurred during the [[Hunt for Zsinj]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]/[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] collaboration against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. Corsin returned under Imperial control after the battle.<ref name="TEA" />
